<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that matches a Still‑Gennari HWE product (an alkene and an ester) by specifying the product SMILES and the bond changes characteristic of the forward reaction (formation of a C=C bond and a C‑O ester bond, breaking of a C‑P bond, a C‑C bond, and a C‑O bond). This should return candidate templates with their IDs.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C=C\\C(=O)O",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-15", "6-6", "6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
